answer: Collateral is slashed jointly when correlated behavioural faults fire inside the same window. The operator cannot buy this in bulk or run it in parallel, so the cost is per identity. The atlas is the collateral at risk, the wander the behavioural signature that groups identities, and the terrace the joint forfeiture that punishes the group: splitting into many wander groups avoids the joint loss but scatters the atlas into smaller, individually useless stakes.
